data.name: Monstrous
data.detailed_description:
Monstrous offers a fresh take on directional melee combat and what a game with a strong combat focus can do in greater context.

If you have enjoyed the fighting pace of Dark Souls, the dueling gameplay of Jedi Academy, the world building of Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver & Vampire: the Masquerade Bloodlines or have fond memories of looting your friends' graves in Moonstone: A Hard Day's Knight we would like to invite you to join us on our journey to breathe new life into the "rivals on a quest" formula in a new, dark fantasy world undergoing industrial revolution.


SKILL BASED, ROBUST MELEE COMBAT

We are bringing competitive fighting game mechanics to the 3rd person action adventure genre. Dodge incoming attacks and aim your blows in skill based melee combat without target locks. Apply pressure to guard crush opponents, employ zoning tactics, block and counter attack enemies to turn the tables and punish turtling foes with grabs. We have built a solid backbone to make a respectable fighting experience accessible and playable in the 3rd person action format.


DIVERSE CAST OF PLAYABLE MONSTERS

Classic Gothic horror characters and villains are presented in a dark graphic novel art style. Player characters with signature fighting styles, powers & skills bring their own approaches and solutions to gameplay scenarios.

SESSION BASED, "ONE MORE GAME" FORMAT

Take on the dangers and secrets of the city in adaptable, short and long play sessions. You can also invite Steam friends to take over other monsters in play for a game night with your buddies, or join other players on the Steam network via quickplay if you prefer a multiplayer experience.


THE CITY IS YOUR PLAYGROUND

Prowl on rooftops to ambush foes, discover items and collect lore bits. Complete shared quests, defeat random encounters and compete for power as you get closer to the final showdown in the ancient heart of the city.

reviews.review:
EDIT: first update came today (1.5 gbs) which added music to the game which is a much needed change. Not sure what else has changed as twice now i have gotten to the marked npc and disappeared through the map while fighting him, which left the game camera spinning where i had last seen my character. I still dont recommend this game, but know now that the devs are actively adding things requested .. Well see how they smooth this game out for now its rough edges are still too prominent..

ORIGINAL (BEFORE EDIT): WOW..... Thought i found a hidden gem with lots of cool influences (moonstone, vampire bloodlines) but instead i found a very low quality alpha game with a great amount of potential. Game has a good setting, cool characters but for a melee based game the melee is clunky with all characters, there are hardly any animations (even for an alpha the animations lacked, like jumping roof to roof feels empty and not fun due to no sound and bad animation).

The graphics on all highs leaves more to be desired, and on top of that the settings are bugged and take many clicks to change just one option. Overall i believe 10 dollars would even be a bit much for this game, but 20 dollars? Come on, might as well have made this free to play before release as a closed alpha type deal, and then release this to steam, the way it was handled by pushing it to steam without even having good animations, no music like in the trailer, and poor melee combat really makes the project look like a cash grab.

Overall i am not liking this game, i have only played single player but i imagine theres not much more fun in multiplayer , especially if i have to fight some other player with these clunky combos and unfluid animations. I wont recommend that you buy this game just yet, if it turns out to NOT be a cash grab then this will be a good purchase---  but ONLY after it gets polished a bit , i mean come on that awesome music in the trailer isnt even in game, in fact theres NO music to help you immerse yourself in this otherwise somewhat interesting world, and all quests are simple "kill and collect" quests, the rivals mode is a good idea but most ppl will look at the coop option and believe it is in game right now and purchase on that alone...
reviews.developer_response:
I am very sorry for your disappointment. The games that we mentioned are really dear to us as well and we want to stand on the shoulders of those giants and make a landmark combat game. We are also aware that the game is not there yet, but it also isn't a cash grab. We simply wanted involve a dedicated community in the development and figured this would be a better way than to crowd-fund with promises and nothing to show for it. 

We want to have feedback from anyone who's willing to provide it, and I sincerely thank you for yours :) If you could take 5 more minutes in the forums to explain why you think the combat is poor besides the animations, I'd really appreciate it.

Oh, and I have to apologize personally for the lack of music. I omitted a few lines of code due to sleep deprivation, it will be up in the first hot fix. I am glad you liked the one in the trailer, it is also playing the hub :)
